$comment: Wording for the reference form. Change wording, hints and error messages here, not in code. Field rules live in ../enquiry-submission.schema.json.
sections: What you'd like to talk about

start.title: Ask about fostering or adoption
body: Use this form to ask a question or set up a chat. It takes about 2 minutes.
In a real service, a named person should tell you when they will reply.
You do not need to know yet whether fostering or adoption is right for you.
We will not ask about your health, your home, your money or your family at this stage.

errors.maxLength: Full name must be 100 characters or fewer

options.hint: For example, a shortened name or a name you prefer.

errors.maxLength: The name we should call you must be 50 characters or fewer

elements.label: What would you like to find out about?

optionHints.not_sure: That's fine. We can talk you through both, and other ways to help.

errors.required: Select what you would like to find out about

elements.label: Are you asking about a child you already know?

options.hint: For example, a grandchild, niece, nephew or a friend's child. This is called kinship care. A different team helps with it. Do not tell us anything about the child here.

errors.required: Select yes if you are asking about a child you already know

elements.label: How would you like us to contact you?

errors.required: Select how you would like us to contact you

options.hint: We'll only use this to reply to you.

errors.pattern: Enter an email address in the correct format, like name@example.org
Enter a phone number in the correct format, like 07700 900 982

elements.label: When is a good time to call? (optional)

options.hint: Select all that apply. We'll try to call at these times.

elements.label: What is the first part of your postcode? (optional)

options.hint: For example, SW1A or ZZ99. We only need the first part to find your local team. We will not ask for your address.

errors.pattern: Enter only the first part of your postcode, like SW1A

pages.section: What you'd like to talk about

elements.label: What would you like to talk about? (optional)

options.hint: Select all that apply. You can also tell us when we talk. Do not share personal details here.

confirmation.builders_body: This is the record the service would receive. The form checked it against the published schema before showing this page.

demo_notice: This is an example form. Do not enter real details. Nothing you enter is sent or stored. Dates in this example do not account for service hours or public holidays.
